confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'the screen going up and down by itself suggests either a software glitch or that the laser dust sensor is being confused by the rug fibres' - hedged, so not flagged, but wrong

rationale: The assistant correctly identified the louder motor and faster battery drop on rug as normal Auto-mode behaviour and asked the right first question about power mode, reassuring the customer that the motor is not failing. However it mis-framed the fluctuating runtime display as a possible 'software glitch' or 'sensor or display fault covered by warranty', when the ground truth says the runtime estimate recalculating is designed behaviour, and it prescribed an unnecessary battery reset and an odd 'switch it off and unplug it' opener. It also referred to a non-existent 'Normal' mode (the V15 has Eco/Auto/Boost) and never checked which head was fitted or whether the behaviour disappears in Eco. The customer leaves with the main symptom correctly explained but with a residual, unfounded suspicion of a screen fault.
